flowVariables.name: issueKey
flowVariables.instruction: Existing Jira issue for this Snyk finding, if any.

Skip findings with no Snyk issue ID.

actions.name: Create Jira Issue from Snyk Finding
actions.description: Create a Jira issue for a Snyk finding that has no open linked issue.

conditions.description: Only create when no open Jira issue is already linked to this Snyk finding.

description: Create Jira issues from open Snyk findings on a schedule

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key where Snyk findings are created and searched.

flowVariables.name: ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira issue type to create for Snyk findings.

flowVariables.name: SNYK_API_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Snyk REST API base URL. Use https://api.eu.snyk.io or https://api.au.snyk.io for those regions.

flowVariables.name: SNYK_APP_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Snyk web app base URL, used to build links in the Jira description.

flowVariables.name: SNYK_ORG_SLUG
flowVariables.instruction: Snyk organization slug, used only to build web links.

flowVariables.name: SNYK_API_VERSION
flowVariables.instruction: Snyk REST API version date. Snyk requires this on every request.

flowVariables.name: SNYK_SEVERITIES
flowVariables.instruction: Comma-separated Snyk severity levels that should raise a Jira issue.
